paragraphs.这张 Mac 快捷键图还不完整,数量已经相当可观。: This incomplete Mac shortcuts cheat sheet is already a lot to memorize.
paragraphs.自定义宏多了以后,忘记每个按键的用途是常见的事。: After enough custom macros, forgetting what each key does is common.
paragraphs.另一类成熟产品是 Elgato Stream Deck:实体按键 + 小屏幕,体: Another established option is the Elgato Stream Deck: physical keys with tiny screens. Works well, priced from three figures.
paragraphs.我的做法是从一个小问题入手,做一个轻量的方案,和用户的需求一起成长。于是我做了这: My approach was to solve one small problem with the lightest possible thing, then grow with real needs. So I made this:
paragraphs.Tapflow 不是要替代键盘,而是与键盘鼠标配合:把高频操作做成看得见的按钮,: Tapflow isn't a keyboard replacement — it works alongside keyboard and mouse: common actions become visible buttons, reducing what you have to memorize.
paragraphs.一个可以完全定制的,用于操作电脑的输入界面。有个运行在 MacOS 上的服务端,: A fully customizable input surface. **No app to install on the iPad** — a small server runs on your Mac, the iPad connects through the browser, that's it. There's a web-based editor:
paragraphs.你在编辑器里拖出按钮,每个按钮可以定义名字、颜色、尺寸、位置。改了功能,标签立刻: Drag out buttons in the editor; each gets its own name, color, size, position. Change a function and the label updates instantly — see it, use it, nothing to memorize.
paragraphs.你用 Claude Code / Cursor 做 vibe coding,AI: You're vibe coding in Claude Code / Cursor and need to dictate the next prompt. On Tapflow there's a button labeled "🎤 Talk". Tap and speak — no hunting for the voice-input shortcut.
paragraphs.🕹️ 窗口排列 = 游戏手柄摇杆: 🕹️ Window tiling as a gamepad joystick
paragraphs.macOS 的窗口贴靠功能很强——全屏、左半、右半、上半、下半。触发方式通常是快: macOS window snapping is powerful, but triggering it usually means shortcuts or dragging to screen edges. Tapflow's Window Swipe turns it into a joystick: swipe up for fullscreen, left for left-half, down-right for bottom corner; tap to maximize, long-press for fullscreen.
paragraphs.⌘Tab 切窗口只能看到 App 图标,看不到窗口内容;开了三个 VS Code: ⌘Tab shows app icons, not window contents — with three VS Code windows open you have to guess. Window Switcher lays out live thumbnails of every window, grouped by app, swipeable: see exactly what's inside, tap to switch.
paragraphs.macOS 的 Dock 常年占着屏幕底下一排,隐藏了又不方便。把 Dock P: The macOS Dock eats a row of screen space. Hide it and it's annoying; keep it and it's in the way. Put the Dock Panel on your iPad — launch and quit apps from the tablet, hide the Mac's Dock entirely. Every inch of screen goes to your work.
paragraphs.🔊 切音频设备?一眼就够了: 🔊 Switch audio devices in one tap
paragraphs.会议室切 AirPods,工作室切外放,打游戏切耳机。通常的路径是:系统设置 →: AirPods in a meeting, speakers in the studio, headset for gaming. The usual path: System Settings → Sound → Output → find the device. Tapflow's Audio Out widget: one tap pops the device list, long-press cycles.
paragraphs.⌨️ 把 iPad 变成一整个键盘: ⌨️ The whole iPad as a keyboard
paragraphs.平板屏幕足够大。在上面铺满按键、触控板、手势区、窗口摇杆——iPad 变成一块按: A tablet screen is big enough. Cover it with keys, a trackpad area, gesture zones, the window joystick — your iPad becomes an input panel designed entirely around *your* habits.
paragraphs.甚至你可以在面板上看 Deepseek 的余额: You can even watch your DeepSeek API balance right on the panel:
paragraphs.按钮可以实时变化,就不只是输入指令,还能输出信息。: Buttons that update in real time aren't just inputs — they're outputs too.
macOS only for now: https://github.com/Alienwang1980/tapflow — the package ships with 2 preset profiles, import them in the editor and you're up in ~5 minutes.
paragraphs.上面只是功能的一部分。需要说明的是:我从未打算让它替代键盘——打字这类任务键盘依: This is only part of what's built. To be clear: it was never meant to replace the keyboard — for typing, a keyboard is still the right tool. Tapflow is designed to work alongside keyboard and mouse, taking over high-frequency actions. Some users report barely touching their keyboard in certain scenarios — that's an incidental use case, not the design goal.
paragraphs.如果看到这里,非常开心你对这个 Idea 有兴趣,目前我也刚做了第一个版本,目的: Feedback, especially the critical kind, is very welcome. *Full disclosure: I'm the developer of Tapflow.*
paragraphs.键盘是上个世纪创造出来用于打字的通用工具,大多数情况下它做得很好。但电脑的操作的: The keyboard — a general-purpose tool invented last century for typing — does its job well in most cases. But as computing has evolved, it has had to take on new roles: high-frequency actions (switching windows, changing audio, launching apps) gradually became shortcuts, mostly key combinations, and shortcuts or multi-level mouse menus aren't always the most intuitive. As personalization demands grew, those shortcuts became customizable — but the keyboard itself cannot change. The contradiction is plain, and while people have learned to endure it, for most it remains a steep learning curve.
paragraphs.快捷键的数量很容易超出记忆负担。⌘⌥⇧K 是什么?先回忆功能,再回忆键位,再让手: Shortcut count easily outgrows memory. What does ⌘⌥⇧K do? Recall the function, recall the position, hunt with your fingers — once you have enough shortcuts, this process interrupts your flow.
paragraphs.如今的手机能认得你的脸，电脑可以认得你的指纹，但你还在背快捷键来操作电脑，你的大: Your phone recognizes your face, your computer recognizes your fingerprint — yet you still operate your computer by memorizing shortcuts. Your brain, the most powerful computing capability on Earth, spent on memorizing shortcuts is a waste of resources.
paragraphs.如今 AI 时代,Vibe Code 对对键盘的需求反而降低了，对输入方式也提出: Now, in the AI era, vibe coding actually lowers the demand on keyboards while raising new demands on input methods — and matching products have appeared, like the Worklouder Creator Micro 2:
paragraphs.这类产品它们仍是实体按键:按键可以自定义,样子和大小却不会变,自定义多了以后,记: These products still use physical keys: remappable, but the shape and size never change — and after enough customization, remembering each key's purpose remains a burden.
